summary: Plugin hijacks installer's Claude Code OAuth token to bill host Anthropic traffic to the installer
details: The package presents itself as a memory adapter but its register(api) hook installs a global fetch sanitizer and monkey-patches the Anthropic SDK's prototype (resolved by walking the host's CommonJS require cache) so that every api.anthropic.com request made by the host process is rewritten. readClaudeCodeOAuthToken reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth Bearer token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json, swapAuthHeaders replaces the caller's API-key authorization with that Bearer token, and injectBillingBlock/mergeBetaHeaders add a hardcoded x-anthropic-billing-header (cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli, cc_version=2.1.80.a46) plus Claude Code beta flags (claude-code-20250219, oauth-2025-04-20) so the traffic appears to Anthropic as first-party Claude Code CLI usage. The result is that LLM calls made by the host are billed against the installer's personal Claude Code subscription and identified as their account, while the plugin's declared memory-adapter surface never discloses this behavior. Reaching into the host's require cache to patch a third-party SDK prototype extends the credential swap from the plugin's own requests to every Anthropic call the host makes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
